title: Principle of Conservation of Linear Momentum

variables.\\vec{F}_{\\text{net, ext}}: Net external force acting on system

assumptions: Holds along any coordinate axis where external force component vanishes
validity_conditions: Universal physical conservation law in classical mechanics
common_misuse: Applying momentum conservation when external impulsive forces act
Applying momentum conservation along an axis experiencing non-zero external force
source_provenance: HCV1 Ch 9 p. 157 eq. 9.13; HRW Ch 9 p. 236; UP Ch 8 p. 271
